_readme: Replace these EXAMPLE questions with real ones about your HOA documents. expect_doc_type is where the answer should come from. Include 1-2 questions your documents do NOT answer to calibrate MAX_DISTANCE.

cases.query: What is the process for approving an exterior change to my home?
When does the landscaping contract renew and how do we cancel?
What did the board decide about the pool last year?
What is the recipe for sourdough bread?
cases.note: Out of scope on purpose: use its distance to calibrate MAX_DISTANCE
